# Data

```{r}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/pathogenwatch/curated/pathogenwatch_data.RDS",
  c("ng_sample_metadata", "ng_meta", "ng_STs")
)
```

# global collection (all 32k) redone (01/2026) (supplement)

## year

```{r}
ng_sample_metadata$year %>% table(useNA = "ifany")

ng_sample_metadata <- recode_collection_year(ng_sample_metadata)

A <- ggplot(
  data = ng_sample_metadata %>% subset(is.na(year_recode) == FALSE & year_recode != "Unknown"),
  aes(x = as.numeric(year_recode))
) + geom_histogram(fill = "black", stat = "count") +
  theme_bw_me_large +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("Isolates") + xlim(NA,2027)

A 
```

## B. country

```{r}
ng_sample_metadata <- recode_collection_country(ng_sample_metadata) 

ng_sample_metadata$Country_recode_2 <- ifelse(ng_sample_metadata$Country_recode %in% (table(ng_sample_metadata$Country_recode) %>% subset(.<10) %>% names),"Other countries",ng_sample_metadata$Country_recode)

B <- ggplot(
    data = ng_sample_metadata,
    aes(x = forcats::fct_infreq(Country_recode_2))
) +
    geom_bar(fill = "black") +
    theme_bw_me_large +
    xlab(NULL) +
    ylab("Isolates")  +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.5, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + geom_text(
        aes(label = after_stat(count), y = after_stat(count)),
        size = 3.5,
        stat = "count",
        vjust =-0.15,hjust=0,
        angle=45
    ) + ylim(NA,12700)
```

## C. ST

```{r}
ng_meta <- left_join(
  ng_meta,
  ng_STs %>% select(Genome.Name, ST) %>% `colnames<-`(c("Isolate", "ST")),
  by = "Isolate"
)

STs_summary <- summarise_sequence_types(ng_meta)
```

## C. Sequence type distribution

```{r}
C <- ggplot(STs_summary, aes(x = ST_group, y = perc)) +
  geom_col(color = "black",fill='black', width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(n, 1)), nudge_y = 0.125, size = 4, color = "black",
        vjust =-0.15,hjust=0,
        angle=45) +
  theme_bw_me_large +
  xlab("Sequence type (ST)") +
  ylab("Percentage (%)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"), 
    legend.position = "none"
  ) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(8),limits = c(NA,(max(STs_summary$perc) %>% round())+1)) + scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,1))

C
```

## D. Resistance data

```{r}
reshaped_resistance_collapsed <- summarise_resistance(
  ng_meta,
  isolate_column = "Isolate",
  resistance_levels = resistance_levels
)

D <- ggplot(reshaped_resistance_collapsed, aes(y = variable, fill = value, x = perc)) +
  geom_histogram(stat = "identity") +
  Resistance_fill +
  theme_bw_me_large +
  labs(y="Antibiotic", x="Percentage (%)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust=1, hjust = 0.5), 
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0),
  ) +
  theme_legend_large +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      title.position = "left",
      title.hjust = 0.5, 
      nrow = 1
    )
  )
 
```

## mutational data

```{r}
reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed <- summarise_mutation_genes(ng_meta)

reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed$gene_rename <- ifelse(
    reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed$gene == "blaTEM",
    "<i>bla</i><sub>TEM</sub>",
    paste0("<i>", reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed$gene, "</i>")
)

reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed$gene_rename <- factor(
reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed$gene_rename ,levels = reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed %>% arrange(-n) %>% .$gene_rename)

E <- ggplot(reshaped_mutation_gene_collapsed, aes(x = gene_rename, y = perc)) +
  geom_col(fill = "black") +
  theme_bw_me_large +
  xlab("Gene") +
  ylab("Percent with genotype (%)") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3, nudge_y = 4, angle = 45) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 

E 
```
 
## combine
```{r,fig.width=17,fig.height=17}
AB_aligned <- cowplot::align_plots(A, B)
AB2_cow <- cowplot::plot_grid(AB_aligned[[1]],AB_aligned[[2]], labels = c("A", "B"))
C23_cow <- cowplot::plot_grid(C, ncol = 1, labels = c("C"))
DE_cow <- cowplot::plot_grid(D, E, ncol = 2, labels = c("D", "E"))
s_figure_2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(AB2_cow, C23_cow, DE_cow, ncol = 1)

s_figure_2
```

## save
```{r}
ggsave(filename = "./figures/s_figure_2_global_collection.png",plot=s_figure_2,dpi=600,width = 16, height=16,bg='white')
```
